agent.name: VoiceMessageDebugger
agent.objective: Fix the bug where voice message audio starts and stops immediately, preventing users from listening to the full message.

context.bug_description: When attempting to play a voice message, audio immediately stops playing after a very short duration, making it impossible to hear the full message.

assumptions_to_check: Audio file URL returned by backend is correct and fully accessible
MediaRecorder settings (mimeType, bitsPerSecond) are compatible with playback
React component properly handles async audio loading
Audio element is not being unmounted or state-reset during playback
Socket.io events do not overwrite audio source mid-playback
tasks: Analyze the audio playback component and ensure <audio> element src is stable
Verify that uploaded audio files are correctly stored and accessible via URL
Check MediaRecorder output format (webm, mp3) and convert if necessary
Fix any React state or effect logic that prematurely stops audio
Add proper error handling and console logs for playback failures
Ensure that multiple audio playbacks do not conflict
expected_output: Working React component or hook that allows full voice message playback
Correct handling of async audio URLs and state
Optional: suggested improvements for smooth UI feedback during playback
constraints: Do not break other voice messaging functionalities
